title: Common
description: Shared enums and value types referenced by the other schemas.

PersonaSlug.description: Persona pack slug (coach, teacher, mom, quartermaster, or a custom pack).

Token.description: Pseudonym token issued by the local vault, e.g. PERSON_7, ORG_3, AMOUNT_2.

Category.description: Quest / record category. Non-general values match the email extractors.

LocalTime.description: Wall-clock time HH:MM in the configured timezone.
